messages:
ava_prod: Quick sync — ACME pilot just asked for a private deployment in their VPC with HSM-backed keying and a burst capacity window for demo day. Need to agree on minimum scope + launch criteria by EOD so sales can lock the date.
laura_pm: Which pilot tier are they on? Is this the MVP ask or a stretch?
sam_eng: If it's MVP, we need to nail down what 'burst capacity' means (QPS / sustained vs short peak). Also: will they want model pinning?
ava_prod: They're expecting 2k qps bursts for ~10 minutes during demo, otherwise ~200 qps baseline. Model pinning yes (specific model sha).
nate_runtime: 2k qps for 10m is doable if we pre-warm and carve a short-lived dedicated pool. Need prewarm plan and autoscaler tweaks. Prefetch/KV cache warmup will be critical.
jules_infra: On infra side we need a maintenance window for routing changes and VPC peering setup. Also RFC for ephemeral dedicated GPU pools — we should avoid manual ops during the demo.
priya_sec: HSM integration ok but requires KMS policy review + audit log retention 90d. Also need to confirm no customer secrets leave their VPC.
laura_pm: Launch criteria proposal: 1) Private control plane connectivity validated, 2) HSM key wrapping test pass, 3) Burst prewarm reaching 2k qps in staging, 4) Canary 10% -> 100% with no errors for 30m. Comments?
sam_eng: Agree but suggest adding latency SLO for demo: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 250ms under 2k qps. If we can't meet p95 we should show degraded mode with fallback.
nate_runtime: For prewarm plan: we'll run a sustained load for 15m in staging with KV prefix warm and a KV-cache prime script. I can share a short script.
ave_prod: @nate_runtime can you post the script + steps? I'll loop in ACME SRE.
nate_runtime: Posting quick prime steps:
```
# prime cache
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/prime -d '{"model":"acme-4bit","prefixes":1000}'
# sustained load (15m)
wrk -t12 -c500 -d900s http://staging-infer/acme/endpoint
```
laura_pm: Nice. Jules, how long to set up ephemeral pool and VPC peering?
jules_infra: VPC peering + routing certs: 2 business days if we have network details. Ephemeral pool deploy + autoscaler: 6-8 hours once images are green. We can schedule peering today if they provide CIDR.
priya_sec: Also listing: HSM attestation check, KMS IAM binding, and audit retention policy. I'll need owner for each check.
sam_eng: I'll own the canary rollout plan + latency SLO tests. Nate will own prewarm scripts. Jules owns infra provisioning. Priya owns security checks. Laura/ava — you coordinate sign-off from ACME.
ava_prod: Sounds good. Can each owner drop a checklist item here by EOD?
priya_sec: Checklist: HSM attestation ✅ (in progress), IAM binding draft ✅, audit retention policy doc WIP.
nate_runtime: Checklist: prime script posted ✅, stage-run completed (pending results) -> will update by 17:30.
sam_eng: Checklist: canary config draft:
```
canary: 10% -> 50% in 15m -> 100% in 45m
monitoring: p95, errors, token-costs
automation: rollback if errors>0.5% or p95>400ms
```
— draft ready, need infra to confirm traffic shaping.
jules_infra: Checklist: vpc peering ETA 48h (if CIDR today), ephemeral pool infra + helm chart ready. I'll post exact runbook after CIDR.
ava_prod: ACME asked about fallback if we can't hit 2k qps — we should agree on a communication plan (graceful degrade to hosted fallback + messaging).
laura_pm: Add fallback criterion: if prewarm fails or p95>350ms at 2k qps, switch to hosted fallback with explicit banner. Also confirm billing/comms for burst usage.
sam_eng: Agree — add a toggle in launch config to flip fallback. I'll add to canary automation.
priya_sec: Last call on data flow: ensure no model artifacts are copied out of their VPC unless explicitly permitted. We'll need sign-off from ACME legal.
ava_prod: I'll get legal + ACME SRE looped.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline for ephemeral-pool: passed all checks — image build 88f3a1 ready. :white_check_mark:
laura_pm: Great — next steps: owners update checklists in this thread by EOD. I'll consolidate into an acceptance doc and share a pre-launch checklist tomorrow AM. Thanks all. :pray:
sam_eng: One more note — we should schedule a 30m dry-run during low traffic window to validate canary automation. Propose tomorrow 09:00 PT.
jules_infra: 09:00 PT works for infra.
priya_sec: Works for security too.
ava_prod: I'll confirm with ACME and post calendar invite.
laura_pm: Closing thread for now, will reopen if any blockers.
